title: Best Tube Bender for Chromoly: Picks by Published 4130 Rating
excerpt: The best tube bender for chromoly has a published 4130 rating. Compare Baileigh, Eastwood and Pro-Tools 4130 capacities, springback tips and more.

asins.product: Eastwood air-hydraulic conversion kit for the High Capacity bender

notes: Roundup ranks ONLY benders with a maker/retailer-published 4130 figure: Baileigh RDB-050 (2 x .120), Eastwood High Capacity (4130 limited to .090 wall), Pro-Tools 105HD (2 x .134 with extension handle, sold direct, non-affiliate link). JD2 Model 32, Rogue Fab M605/M625 and Woodward WFB2 are explained as 'no published 4130 rating found' - if the editor finds an official 4130 figure for any of them, it could be added. Conflicts stated in text: Eastwood OD range (Amazon listing 3/4-2 in vs Eastwood instruction sheet 21115Q 1-2 in, the latter via fact-check notes/search summary), Baileigh 190 vs 200 degrees, Rogue Fab M605 .188 vs .250 wall. Rule statements: SCCA Time Trials 3x centerline bend radius (timetrials.scca.com full safety rules, via search summary); NHRA TIG for 4130 from the 2017 and 2019 General Regulations on promod.nhra.com (via search summary), linked to nhraracer.com/rules for the current 2026 book. Direct page fetches were blocked (DNS), and the session's web-search budget ran out, so no new ASINs were verified: only kit-verified ASINs are used. Left out as unverifiable: JD2 4130 rating, Rogue Fab 4130 rating, Baileigh RDB-100/RDB-175 4130 capacities, any 4130 springback degree figures beyond JD2's 'about 2x'.
